review: Code-blind full-resolution review of 60 named-fight frames for south_bridge_grunt and warden_aldis
confirmed_findings: P2-062: combat camera often crowded or clipped by large ally and opponent geometry
P2-063: tell and hit effects rely on text and flat overlays
P2-064: thick turquoise Warden arena floor rails
P2-065: trainer defeated state weakly differentiated from pre-fight post
notes: The full victory dialogue remains legible in later Warden frames. The Camera nickname on the ally may be intentional and was not scored. Stills do not establish animation timing or sound.
